howto.what: 当你要写 Ruby/Rails 代码或测试时，Claude 会先查阅语言和测试的参考文件，确保代码风格与现有项目一致。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或修改 Ruby/Rails 代码、RSpec/Minitest 测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Rails 模型，包含验证和关联。
say.note: Claude 会先读取参考文件再生成代码。

say.text: 给这个 Ruby 方法写 RSpec 测试。
say.note: Claude 会参考测试规范来编写。

howto.what_en: When you write Ruby/Rails code or tests, Claude first reads language and test reference files to ensure code style matches the existing project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or modify Ruby/Rails code, RSpec/Minitest tests.

say_en.text: Write a Rails model with validations and associations.
say_en.note: Claude reads references first then generates code.

say_en.text: Write RSpec tests for this Ruby method.
say_en.note: Claude follows test guidelines from references.
